reasoning: The icon depicts two counter-clockwise curved arrows orbiting a central solid dot, universally read as sync, refresh, cycle, or rotate around a pivot. It fits tasks centered on data synchronization or periodic physical rotation (mattresses, tires, stock, keys), though it competes closely with plain sync/refresh arrows and is secondary whenever a concrete physical object is the task's main noun.
